data.translation:
The Corruption Eradication Commission (KPK) has provided clarification regarding the house owned by Jampidsus of the Attorney General's Office, Febrie Adriansyah, in the Sentul area, Bogor Regency, which is not registered in the State Organizer's Wealth Report (LHKPN).

KPK's Deputy for Prevention and Monitoring, Aminudin, stated that his side has conducted an investigation regarding this matter. He mentioned that the house is suspected to be registered under someone else's name, alias a nominee.

"An examination of the relevant LHKPN has been conducted; the house in Sentul is suspected to be under a nominee's name," said Aminudin to reporters on Friday (7/10).

This house in Sentul has been the subject of much discussion following the police raid related to corruption allegations. From there, investigators seized several pieces of evidence, ranging from gold to cash.

Previously, Febrie had acknowledged that the house in Sentul belonged to him.

"The second one is about the Sentul house, yes. That is indeed the personal residence of the Jampidsus that has been owned for a long time. The ownership process from the beginning can be seen," said Febri in response to reporters' questions during a press conference at the Attorney General's Office of the Republic of Indonesia, South Jakarta, on Friday (7/10).

📸: Dok. Antara.⁠

result.text:
Komisi Pemberantasan Korupsi (KPK) memberikan penjelasan terkait rumah milik Jampidsus Kejagung, Febrie Adriansyah, di kawasan Sentul, Kabupaten Bogor, yang tidak terdaftar di Laporan Harta Kekayaan Penyelenggara Negara (LHKPN).

Deputi Pencegahan dan Monitoring KPK, Aminudin, mengatakan pihaknya telah melakukan penelusuran terkait hal ini. Ia menyebut, rumah itu diduga terdaftar atas nama orang lain alias nominee.

"Sudah dilakukan pemeriksaan atas LHKPN yang bersangkutan, rumah yang di Sentul diduga atas nama nominee," kata Aminudin kepada wartawan, Jumat (10/7).

Rumah di Sentul ini banyak menjadi perbincangan usai digeledah Polri terkait dugaan korupsi. Dari sana, penyidik menyita sejumlah barang bukti, mulai dari emas hingga uang tunai.

Sebelumnya, Febrie telah mengakui bahwa rumah di Sentul itu adalah miliknya.

"Yang kedua tentang rumah Sentul, ya. Itu memang rumah pribadi Jampidsus yang sudah sejak lama. Itu bisa dilihat bagaimana proses kepemilikan sejak awal," kata Febri menjawab pertanyaan wartawan saat konferensi pers di Kejagung RI, Jakarta Selatan pada Jumat (10/7).
